shared_elements: upright slab/pillar carved in low relief on its broad face
a row/register of repeated small elements near the top
small subsidiary figures placed beside a larger figure
low-relief carving with flat raised surfaces against a plain ground
justification: Both are broad upright slabs bearing low-relief figural imagery organized into loose horizontal bands, with small repeated elements in an upper register and animal-like profile forms below, which is about as generic as such correspondence gets. A shows clearly identifiable, isolated, schematic zoomorphs (a quadruped with open jaws, a large long-necked bird, snake-like and insect-like forms) set apart on empty ground, whereas B shows a densely packed, ornate composition dominated by an elaborately costumed anthropomorphic figure with plumed/feathered attributes and dense filler detail — different subjects rendered by different conventions.
